# LGS Card Vault

> Player-first marketplace for Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon, One Piece, Flesh & Blood, and other TCGs sold by verified local game stores.

LGS Card Vault (https://lgscardvault.com) lets players browse real store inventory, check out online or in store, and sell or trade cards back to shops they already trust. Store owners get a branded storefront, CSV inventory import, Square checkout, events, and a Commander deck builder.

## Start here

- Homepage: https://lgscardvault.com/
- Store directory: https://lgscardvault.com/stores
- Open a store: https://lgscardvault.com/register/owner
- Player account: https://lgscardvault.com/register/customer
- Agent overview (Markdown): https://lgscardvault.com/index.md
- Auth for agents: https://lgscardvault.com/auth.md
- Public OpenAPI (unauthenticated surface): https://lgscardvault.com/openapi.json
- API catalog: https://lgscardvault.com/.well-known/api-catalog

## Public HTTP API (same origin, prefix `/api`)

- `GET /api/stores` — approved storefronts
- `GET /api/stores/{slug}` — one store
- `GET /api/stores/{slug}/inventory` — singles in stock
- `GET /api/health` and `GET /api/health/ready` are exposed as `/health` and `/health/ready` on the site origin
- `POST /api/contact` — landing-page contact form (rate limited)

Storefront URLs follow `/s/{slug}` (inventory, sealed, mass search, deck builder, sell/trade, events, cart).

## Do not crawl

Admin, account, and raw API collection dumps: `/platform`, `/account`, `/s/*/admin`, `/api/`. Prefer HTML storefronts and the documented public GET endpoints.

## Optional skill

- Browse inventory: https://lgscardvault.com/skills/browse-lgs-inventory/SKILL.md
